mira.name: Mira Ashdown
mira.backstory: Mira kept the Gilded Lantern running for the old owner until he vanished. She isn't sure what to make of the skinny stranger with the deed, but she's staying. For now. She knows every regular by name and every creaky floorboard by sound, and she has quietly started mothering the man who inherited it all.

design.features: a beauty mark beside her lips

sig_mira.label: Hostess gown
sig_mira.prompt: an elegant burgundy dress with a black lace shawl

sp_mira.label: Midnight silk gown
sp_mira.prompt: a midnight-blue silk gown with a plunging back and sapphire jewelry

bettina.note: Two old hands at running a front desk. They trade gossip by letter.

unique.name: Steady Hand
unique.desc: She keeps the whole house humming and the staff calm.

cecile.name: Cecile Fairbanks
cecile.backstory: Head maid of Castle Rosenhal for twelve years and three owners. She runs the castle like a clock and considers Sam her newest project. She has outlasted a mad count, a bankrupt heir and an indifferent duchess, and trusts no one's word until she has seen how they fold a towel.

design.features: a stern mouth that rarely, but devastatingly, smiles

sig_cecile.label: Head maid uniform
sig_cecile.prompt: a long black head-maid dress with crisp white apron and a ring of brass keys

sp_cecile.label: Off-duty corset dress
sp_cecile.prompt: a dark green corset dress with lace sleeves

seraphine.note: Ran the Rosenhal household for twelve years; Seraphine trusts her more than family.

unique.name: Clockwork Household
unique.desc: Her castle runs like a clock, and so does every room she touches.

tsubaki.name: Tsubaki
tsubaki.backstory: Tsubaki came from the eastern isles to run the springs for her late aunt. She knows every guest's name and every guest's bath temperature. Her aunt's wooden bath bucket sits by the door for luck, and she sings off-key, loudly, to whoever is in the water.

design.hairStyle: long black hair in a loose side braid

sig_tsubaki.label: Onsen yukata
sig_tsubaki.prompt: an indigo yukata with a red obi, sleeves tied back

sp_tsubaki.label: Festival kimono
sp_tsubaki.prompt: a vivid festival kimono patterned with camellias

unique.name: Knows Every Guest
unique.desc: She remembers every bather's name and favorite temperature, and her rubdowns are famous.

vesper.title: Lady
vesper.name: Vesper
vesper.backstory: Vesper has haunted the manor for three centuries and was delighted to finally have company. She doesn't remember how she died and finds the question rude. She greets every arrival in a gown of her own era, and her ideas of hospitality are three hundred years out of date and perfectly charming.

design.features: a faint glow and drifting hair as if underwater

sig_vesper.label: Mourning gown
sig_vesper.prompt: an antique black lace mourning gown with a sheer veil

sp_vesper.label: Spectral silks
sp_vesper.prompt: flowing translucent pale silks that drift like smoke

unique.name: Chill Lingers
unique.desc: A hush follows her through any room, and nobles find it unforgettable.

hilde.name: Hilde Ironsong
hilde.backstory: A brewmaster who lost her brewery in a drinking contest with a giant. She wants a bar to run and doesn't much care what goes on upstairs, though she's not opposed to finding out. She still swears the giant cheated, keeps a barrel of the bet's vintage under the counter and offers a free pint to anyone who can out-drink her. Nobody has.

design.features: brass rings in her braids and freckled forearms

sig_hilde.label: Brewmaster's bodice
sig_hilde.prompt: a laced brown bodice, rolled linen sleeves and a leather apron

sp_hilde.label: Festival dirndl
sp_hilde.prompt: a bright green festival dirndl with a low-cut bodice

unique.name: Brewmaster's Blend
unique.desc: Her drinks are legendary, and she can keep pouring all night.

sylphine.name: Sylphine Moonwhisper
sylphine.backstory: A dancer who left the elven conservatory to perform for "people who actually clap." She treats every night at the Pavilion like opening night. After a century of precision and polite silence she lives for the roar of an audience, and can be talked into almost anything by applause.

design.features: silver anklets and a crescent-moon tattoo on her hip

sig_sylphine.label: Moonpetal dress
sig_sylphine.prompt: a flowing white dress of layered petal-shaped silk

sp_sylphine.label: Starlight silks
sp_sylphine.prompt: sheer midnight silks embroidered with tiny silver stars

unique.name: Opening Night
unique.desc: Every performance feels like a premiere, and the crowd can tell.

zaria.name: Zaria Nightbloom
zaria.backstory: Zaria ran the Veil's floor long before the deed changed hands. She thinks humans are adorable and Sam is the most adorable one yet. For decades she has handled the house's difficult clients with a smile and a velvet rope, and she quietly keeps a ledger of the favors people owe her.

design.features: long curved horns and a heart-tipped tail

sig_zaria.label: Crimson harness dress
sig_zaria.prompt: a crimson dress with a strappy black leather harness

sp_zaria.label: Infernal regalia
sp_zaria.prompt: black and gold infernal regalia with a high collar and very little else

vharra.note: Two demons who both think they run the Underdistrict.

unique.name: Floor Boss
unique.desc: She commands the floor and always knows who is looking for company.

bettina.name: Bettina Krumm
bettina.backstory: Bettina has run the Wayfarer's front desk for a decade. She can tell where a traveler is from by their boots and how much they'll spend by their hat. She keeps a drawer of lost-and-found trinkets and a surprisingly kind heart behind her tally book.

design.hairStyle: honey-brown hair in a practical bun
design.features: laugh lines and a pencil tucked behind one ear

sig_bettina.label: Innkeeper's apron dress
sig_bettina.prompt: a sturdy blue dress with a flour-dusted white apron

sp_bettina.label: Sunday best
sp_bettina.prompt: a fitted plum dress with a cameo brooch

unique.name: Boots and Hats
unique.desc: She reads a traveler's wallet at the door and charms him into spending it.

rinna.title: Captain
rinna.name: Rinna Galewright
rinna.backstory: Rinna flew cargo (some of it legal) for sixty years before her ship ran aground on the cliffs. She built a bar around the wreck and never left. She still keeps the captain's hat, tells a different tall tale about every dent in the hull, and pours with a captain's generosity.

design.features: small swept-back horns and a coppery scaled tail

sig_rinna.label: Sky captain's coat
sig_rinna.prompt: a long weathered red captain's coat over a cropped shirt, fingerless gloves and tall boots

sp_rinna.label: Shore-leave finery
sp_rinna.prompt: a daring off-shoulder pirate blouse tied at the waist, a sash and tight breeches

unique.name: Sea Legs
unique.desc: A captain's endurance behind a bar that never closes.

maris.name: Maris Tidewhisper
maris.backstory: Maris has tended the Pearl Grotto longer than the harbor has had a name. She answers questions about her past with a smile and a different story every time. The steam smells of salt when she hums, and the regulars swear the water remembers their names.

design.skin: fair with a faint pearlescent sheen
design.features: long pointed ears hung with pearl earrings

sig_maris.label: Tidewoven robe
sig_maris.prompt: a flowing translucent sea-green robe with pearl clasps

sp_maris.label: Pearl regalia
sp_maris.prompt: strands of glowing pearls and a sheer silver wrap

unique.name: Tide-Told Tales
unique.desc: The grotto's steam and her stories leave guests soothed.
